hero.title: Front-End Developer
hero.intro: Professional Front-End Developer specializing in building modern, responsive, and high-performance websites and web applications. I have experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, along with modern tools and technologies such as Bootstrap and Tailwind CSS. I focus on writing clean, organized, and maintainable code, transforming ideas and designs into interactive and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring compatibility across different screen sizes and devices. I have experience working with REST APIs and developing dynamic applications. I am also skilled in using AI tools to assist with code generation, code optimization, speeding up development, and solving technical problems. I always strive to deliver professional web solutions that combine high performance, functionality, and modern design.
